info.title: Vela CLI — Build Dataverse with confidence
info.description: Vela command-line tool (command: vela). Plan/apply, scaffolding and package signing for Microsoft Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Register Dataverse plugins and Custom APIs from your build packages.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a plugin, service, Custom API, test or step to a project.

options.name: --entity
options.description: Table model type (plugin/service/step; optional for customapi).

options.name: --message
options.description: SDK message (plugin/step/test).

options.name: --stage
options.description: PreValidation | PreOperation | PostOperation.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Sync | Async.

options.name: --filtering-attributes
options.description: Columns the step filters on (required for Create/Update).

options.name: --handler
options.description: Handler method name (step).

options.name: --kind
options.description: plugin | customapi (test).

options.name: --bound
options.description: Entity-bound Custom API.

options.name: --global
options.description: Global (unbound) Custom API.

options.name: --function
options.description: Custom API is a function.

options.name: --action
options.description: Custom API is an action.

options.name: --prefix
options.description: Custom API publisher prefix (customapi/test; default: the project's VelaPublisherPrefix).

options.name: --project
options.description: Target project (default: the single .csproj in the current folder).

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing file (not step; test completes an existing class without it).

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Guided wizard.

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output on stdout (see docs/reference/machine-readable-output.md).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Notes:
plugin <Name> --entity <ModelType> [--message] [--stage] [--mode] [--filtering-attributes] (required for Create/Update(+Multiple)).
service <Name> --entity <ModelType>.
customapi <Name> [--entity <ModelType>] [--bound|--global] [--function|--action] [--prefix <publisherprefix>].
test <Name> [--kind plugin|customapi] [--entity] [--message] [--prefix]: run inside the test project (RootNamespace ending in .Tests). An existing test class is completed with the tests of the steps it lacks.
step <PluginName> --entity <ModelType> [--message] [--handler] [--stage] [--mode] [--filtering-attributes]: edits an existing multi-step plugin.
form-script|ribbon-script <entity> [--project <web-resources dir>] [--force]: (preview).
Each kind accepts only its own options. A Custom API is named <publisherprefix>_<Name>: --prefix, else the project's VelaPublisherPrefix, else the project prefix.
